branch_provenance.syndrome: Chronic Progressive Cutaneous Vascular Tumor with Septal Absence and Irregular Vessels

state.case_summary:
A man in his 40s presented with a slowly growing tumor on the scalp. The patient was otherwise healthy with no significant medical history.

Skin examination revealed an 8-mm red, firm, mobile nodule on the left temporal scalp. Dermoscopic evaluation showed irregular red lacunae with irregular vessels and absence of septa.
